svg.text: R3-I030 | one frozen exterior transfer hoop
29 m centreline radius, z = 0; 76 m hull; four full bag envelopes. Unloaded geometry, not a fit or equilibrium certificate.
Teal: finite hoop red: paid receiver members gold: ropes blue: guide guards grey: retained frames
10 m scale; widths shown where resolved
10 m scale; widths shown where resolved
10 m scale; widths shown where resolved
Finite construction details — exact dimensions below; detail panels have independent scales
26 mm groove; 18 mm rope + paid tails
45° curved sector; bolt group r = 210 mm
Prying, slip, fatigue and plate flexure UNKNOWN
4 gussets + 8 M24 bolts at each end
60 × 250 mm steel axial pin; double shear
Bolted flanges must also transmit full moment
Existing rack receiver → paid root → curtain
Eight mappings and exact xyz are in hoop.json
Curves use saved finite tangencies; small red points mark entry/exit. Guide guards are drawn in their actual 3D planes.
Full bag circles are projected envelopes. Apparent separation in one panel is not a 3D clearance result; use saved witnesses.
RHS, splices, roots, hardware, access and retained duties are paid once. Conservative capsule bounds do not certify joints.
No loaded global shape, coupled ring/curtain compatibility, contact solution or physical float is established by this drawing.
Source: hoop.json and sources.json. Reproduce with: python3 research/design-iterations/R3-I030/draw.py
